Subject: Everholt Inns - Referral Required

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the submission on Everholt Inns. I've reviewed the information and everything looks complete—appreciate the thorough package.

However, hospitality risks require referral to our senior underwriting team for approval before I can move forward with quoting. Before I send this up, could you help me with a few questions?

- What are the primary operations at each location (hotel, motel, B&B, etc.)?
- Are there any restaurants, bars, or pools on premises?
- What fire protection is in place at each location?
- Any recent renovations or updates to the properties?

Once I have these details, I'll escalate this for review and circle back with next steps.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
